scope: Independent inspection of all five original actual Windows full-stack PNGs; no final application, physical GPU or aesthetic acceptance claim.
observations: All five actual captures retain true orthographic side elevation, crisp native material edges and bright physical Play silhouettes separated from darker rear geometry.

The same design weaknesses observed on Linux remain visible: sparse disconnected orbital horizon, low far skyline, repeated hollow machinery rectangles, detached far cavern strips and portrait lower rear-panel overshoot.
Presentation-only haze and steam are restrained and sometimes difficult to discern at whole-scene scale; final matched details and owner interaction must judge whether their strength is useful.
Generator-v2 decorative refinements address the observed geometry weaknesses but require a new exact-source Windows execution; the original frames cannot certify those revisions.
Every recorded Windows admission exceeded the predeclared45second target. These original misses are retained rather than recast as success or hidden by a new target.
The reported adapter is ANGLE over Microsoft Basic Render Driver. This is hosted software-rendering evidence, not a physical Windows11/NVIDIA performance or appearance decision.
